work.description: The act condemns the Piedmontese laws against the Church. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF154-158) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF298-302 reads: ALLOCUTIO HABITA IN C0N81STORIO SECRETO DIE 22 JANUARII 1855 Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
